caption: Technician versus General as two worlds: today your all-band VHF/UHF privileges reach locally and regionally, with only CW slivers on 80/40/15 m and one SSB slice of 10 m at 200 W PEP; passing Element 3 lights up phone and data segments on every HF band from 80 through 10 m at up to 1.5 kW PEP while keeping all VHF/UHF — though the lowest slices of 80, 40, 20, and 15 m remain Advanced/Amateur Extra territory, and 160, 60, 30, 17, and 12 m open as well.
spoken: two panels — your Technician world today: local VHF-UHF with small CW slivers of HF; and your General world after Element 3: worldwide, with phone and data lit up on every HF band
